description: Fix P0 security and reliability issues from GitHub issues: JWT secret validation (#90), Turnstile enforcement (#91), refresh token revocation (#94), chat endpoint exception handling (#126), health check duplicate prefix (#127), streaming input sanitization (#134), and PostHog singleton (#168).
steps: Issue #90 - Dangerous Default JWT Secret: The config.py already has validate_production_secrets() that rejects known placeholders in production and main.py logs a warning. However, the .env.shared still has the dangerous default. Update .env.shared to have a comment-only placeholder (no actual value) for JWT_SECRET, making it clear it MUST be set. Also ensure APP_ENV=development default makes the dev experience smooth. ALREADY FIXED in code - just needs .env.shared update.

Issue #91 - Turnstile Bot Protection: The edge worker (apps/edge/src/index.ts) already enforces Turnstile as MANDATORY for auth and chat POST endpoints (lines 45-68). This issue is ALREADY FIXED. Add a brief comment in the edge worker noting that Turnstile is mandatory (not optional) per security policy.

Issue #94 - Refresh Tokens Cannot Be Revoked: The auth.py already implements jti-based revocation via Redis in the /refresh and /logout endpoints. This is ALREADY FIXED. Verify the implementation is correct.

Issue #126 - Chat Endpoint Catches All Exceptions: The chat.py endpoint already has granular exception handling (RuntimeError, TimeoutError, HTTPStatusError, ValueError) before the catch-all Exception handler. The catch-all returns a generic 500 without leaking internals. This is ALREADY FIXED with proper logging. No change needed.

Issue #127 - Health Check Router Registered at Two Prefixes: In main.py, the health router is registered at /health prefix. There are also /api/health and /api/health/deep routes that do RedirectResponse(url='/health', status_code=301). This is intentional for backward compatibility. Add a code comment explaining this is a deliberate legacy redirect, not a duplicate registration.

Issue #134 - Streaming Endpoint Sends Unsanitized Message to LLM: The chat_stream endpoint in chat.py calls sanitize_user_input() on the message before passing it to ChatService methods. However, in the stream_llm call, it also passes request_message=request.message (the ORIGINAL unsanitized message). Fix this: change request_message=request.message to request_message=sanitized_message in the chat_stream endpoint.

Issue #168 - PostHog Instance is a Local Variable: In main.py lifespan(), PostHog is correctly stored on app.state.posthog (not a local variable). The utils/posthog.py correctly retrieves it from request.app.state. This is ALREADY FIXED. No change needed.
acceptance_criteria: .env.shared JWT_SECRET line clearly indicates it must be changed, not left as default
The streaming chat endpoint only passes sanitized messages to the LLM (no raw request.message leak)
Health check backward compatibility is documented with comments
Edge worker Turnstile enforcement is documented
Backend tests still pass after changes
verification: grep 'sanitized_message' apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py shows sanitized_message is used in stream_llm call (not request.message)
findings: All 4 changes implemented successfully. 3 pre-existing test failures confirmed (test_chat_rate_limit_returns_429, test_chat_error_does_not_leak_details, test_login_invalid_credentials) - they fail on base state due to mock mismatch in check_rate_limit (returns 3 values, code expects 4) and beanie CollectionWasNotInitialized. 31 tests pass.
